mainEntity.name: How do I compare AI product development tools without wasting money?

acceptedAnswer.text: Choose tools by workflow fit rather than by the largest feature list. A research assistant, course-building assistant, video workflow, or launch workflow may each be useful, but combining them too early can create more setup and review work. Run My AI Business describes a library of adaptable bot blueprints, not 38 identical software products. Key factors: task clarity, output quality, integration needs, data handling, cost, and ease of revision. Practical guidance: compare two or three options using the same sample task and score accuracy, edit time, repeatability, and total monthly cost.
acceptedAnswer.description: Compare tools on the same real task, not on marketing claims. Score output quality, editing time, repeatability, integrations, data controls, and total cost. Pick the tool that fits one important workflow, test it for a short period, and expand only when the results justify the added complexity.
